title: Your First Strumming Pattern: Beat-1 Strum in 4/4 Time (JustinGuitar)
summary: JustinGuitar’s beginner-focused lesson introduces the foundational strumming pattern by teaching players to strike on the first beat of a 4/4 bar. The video explains that early material uses 4/4 time (four beats per bar), shows how to count 1–2–3–4, and then guides the learner to strum down on beat 1 while keeping the hand moving on beats 2–4. It emphasizes coordinating chord changes with beat 1, acknowledges common early-week difficulties, and suggests practicing with a backing track or the Beginner Song Course app to reinforce the on-beat strum. The aim is a solid, repeatable beat-1 strum as a foundation for playing songs, with a realistic progression from beat-1-only strumming toward fuller rhythm once coordination improves."
